proposition: On who the R. Ḥurūf was for, the dissertation is hedged and the later papers are not. The dissertation says it was written at the request of a dignitary, perhaps Iskandar Mīrzā, completed 10 Ramaḍān 817/23 November 1414 in Shiraz shortly after Iskandar's rebellion was quashed, and that it is 'possible' Iskandar personally commissioned it. Grammatology says it was written in Shiraz in 817/1414 for Iskandar; New Brethren says written for Iskandar in 1414 and referenced by him in his Sultanic Compendium preface; the Sensorium says it defined Iskandar's programme. The dissertation's own footnote places completion after Iskandar's fall.

mediation.who: R. Ḥurūf colophon date, MS Majlis 10196 f. 157b (copied 828/1425)
mediation.note: the 817/1414 date is the work's own completion note; the earliest copy is 828/1425
